notes.title: 🧧 "Rest in Peace" Demo Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We've just released a major update for the [i]Rest in Peace[/i] demo! This patch introduces a brand new hero [b]White Raven[/b] with her innate skill [b]Burning Raven[/b], along with [b]difficulty settings[/b], [b]achievement support[/b], and over 30 improvements and optimizations.[/p][p][b]💡 Highlighted Changes:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]New playable hero: White Raven + innate skill "Burning Raven"[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty selection: Novice / Normal / Hard[/p][/*][*][p]9 Steam achievements now available in demo[/p][/*][*][p]Core system upgrades: shields, soulstones, skill awakenings, save system[/p][/*][*][p]Major optimizations: UI feedback, controller support, translations, performance[/p][/*][/olist][p]Try out the new version and let us know what you think!
— [i]Rest in Peace[/i] Dev Team[/p][p][/p][h3]🔥 Patch Notes – Demo Update for [i]Rest in Peace[/i][/h3][olist][*][p]Added new hero [b]White Raven[/b], with an innate skill [b]Burning Crow[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added overhead HP bars for key enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]V-Sync setting[/b] — toggleable in the options menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Added awakening effects for [b]Jianlai[/b] and [b]Burning Crow[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added new [b]Thunder Pestle[/b] Stone, replacing the old HP-recovery-on-overflow-damage Stone.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Difficulty Selection[/b]: Novice, Normal, and Hard modes now available.[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded [b]Exhaustion Stone[/b] to include level upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Damage Conversion Stones[/b] now trigger Five Elements status effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Picking up [b]Offerings[/b] now knocks back nearby enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Added transition effect when entering portal after stage clear.[/p][/*][*][p]New popup [b]Welcome Screen[/b] added.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced new [b]Area-type Stones[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced new [b]Shield mechanic[/b] and related Offerings.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new [b]Ending Transition[/b] sequence.[/p][/*][*][p]Added quick link for [b]Feedback Submission[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Damage Interval Protection[/b]: characters can’t be hit again within 0.1s of damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Hero Talent system[/b], with the first talent unlocked by default.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Save System[/b]: partial progress and settings can now be saved.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Tutorial Mode[/b] for first-time players — auto-enabled at first, unlocks after completion.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Achievements[/b] system — 9 achievements available in demo.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated [b]Edge Bounce Stone[/b] icon to reflect its non-upgradable nature.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated stats UI to show [b]resistance and proc rate conversions[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Updated [b]damage number display[/b], now includes status effect indicators.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated hero [b]Ah Cong's[/b] basic attack to [b]Jianlai[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced hero visuals in [b]inventory UI[/b] with new character art.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved item [b]drop effects[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced visual clutter for [b]MP shortage[/b] and [b]Yin-Spell cooldown[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized [b]texture memory usage[/b], reducing overall RAM consumption.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized [b]loading system[/b], reduced pool size for better performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Stones now [b]remain equipped after synthesis[/b], placed in topmost slot.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced stage design in [b]Normal Mode[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]gamepad control[/b] logic for smoother handling.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked [b]Stone Tower defense event[/b] — now heals only when standing in zone.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated [b]mouse cursor style[/b], with new click animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visibility of [b]Disturbance Events[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]English localization[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Refined [b]hero hit reaction visuals[/b].[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Rest In Peace Devlog: Hero Skill Rework & Auto-Cast Stone!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone! Thanks for your continued support. Here’s the latest development update for [i]Rest In Peace[/i]:[/p][p]1️⃣ [b]Hero Skill Rework[/b]: We’ve redesigned our hero’s skills, adding more combos and tactical options to make combat deeper and more exciting![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277530/db3dd8f6f2ca55427d4dd595637a80bb8cbc2e94.png"][/img]
2️⃣ [b]Auto-Cast Rune Added[/b]: Equip your hero with a new Auto-Cast Rune to unleash skills automatically – enjoy hands-free chaos![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277530/b87447d86b9375b4dbb16953bbdc044d5e3cd73a.png"][/img]
3️⃣ [b]New Hero in Development[/b]: A brand-new hero is on the way, bringing unique abilities and fresh gameplay. Stay tuned![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277530/e5873f7389d20df65664f4b933e0be6a78b116ec.png"][/img][/p][p]Don’t forget to join our Discord to chat with us and get the latest news first![/p]
